capture.title: Scan a bill or receipt
capture.intro: Photograph a restaurant bill or grocery receipt and we'll turn it into a transaction — item by item.
capture.dropHint: Or drop an image or PDF here. JPEG, PNG or a PDF bill.
capture.aiNote: This sends the photo to our AI reader once. It isn't stored — by us or anyone else.
capture.noCredits: You're out of AI credits this month. You can still edit the receipt by hand.
capture.privacy: Receipts are read on your device. Photos are never saved.

unclear.title: We couldn't read this cleanly
unclear.noLines: We couldn't find any items on this receipt.
unclear.noTotal: We read the items but couldn't find the total.
unclear.mismatch: The items we read don't add up to the printed total.

errors.pdfNoText: That PDF has no readable text — try photographing the receipt instead.
errors.unsupportedFile: That file type is not supported. Use a JPEG, PNG or PDF.

premium.body: Reading a bill and turning it into an itemised transaction runs on AI, so it's part of the Lite and Pro plans. You can still add transactions by hand on any plan.
premium.title: A Lite or Pro feature

review.title: Check the details
review.intro: We read this off the receipt — fix anything that looks wrong before saving.
review.needTotal: Enter the total printed on the receipt.
review.offBy: Lines add up to {{computed}}, but the receipt says {{stated}}.
review.pickGroup: Choose a group, or name a new one.
review.splitNote: Next you'll assign each item to whoever had it, and choose how tax and service charge are shared.
review.mustBalance: The lines need to add up to the total before this can be saved.
review.notFound: That scan is no longer available.
review.corrupt: We couldn't reopen this scan. Please scan it again.

split.title: Who had what?
split.intro: Assign each item, then choose how tax and service charge are shared.
split.fixLines: Fix the highlighted lines to continue.
split.notFound: That scan is no longer available.
